newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Nov trade surplus widens to $25.9 bln.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Nov trade surplus widens to $25.9 bln.

text.p: Russia posted a trade surplus of $25.9 billion in the first 11 months of this year after a $22.4 billion surplus in the same period of 1995, the State Statistics Committee said.
Earlier the committee reported a surplus of $23.1 billion which was preliminary data.
RUSSIAN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Nov 96 Jan-Oct 96 Jan-Nov 95

Notes -- Figures in billion dollars, FOB. Data are for trade with Russia's "far abroad" excluding former Soviet states. Including trade with former Soviet republics, the surplus widened to $25.2 billion from $18.9 billion a year ago.
